sections.content: Professional communication combines description, obligation, explanation, refusal and requests for clarification. A refusal can state the limitation, give a reason and propose a practical alternative.

items.spanish: No puedo aceptar el cambio de plazo porque tengo que terminar otro proyecto.
items.english: I cannot accept the change to the deadline because I have to finish another project.

items.spanish: Necesito aclarar un punto antes de rechazar la propuesta.
items.english: I need to clarify one point before refusing the proposal.

items.spanish: Se requiere más información, así que sería mejor esperar antes de decidir.
items.english: More information is required, so it would be better to wait before deciding.

items.spanish: Entiendo la petición, pero no puedo comprometerme a entregar el informe mañana.
items.english: I understand the request, but I cannot commit to delivering the report tomorrow.

sections.content: Professional refusals are clearer when they state the limitation, give a reason and, where possible, suggest what can be done instead.
